title: 61 - A Trivia Game
summary: A phone-first quiz-show game. Two boards of clues, hidden doubles, a wagered final and two computer opponents who race you to the buzzer. Type your answers, or handwrite the final one. Easy, Normal and Hard pools, a practice buzzer mode, and career stats kept on your phone.

title: Frontier Lab
summary: An AI-lab tycoon. Found a small lab, hire your researchers, train your models and ship products, then grow it into a global company, all on an engraved isometric city map. Early days: the map and title screen are up and the lab itself is being built.

title: Prairie Engine Works
summary: Longlight's biggest game so far. Put an engine together on the test stand, fire it up and hear it run, then take it to the drag strip or a truck and tractor pull to earn cash and reputation.

title: The Whip
summary: A political career game for your phone. Start as a rookie backbench MP in the 120-seat House of Commons of the made-up Dominion of Caledor and climb to Chief Whip: the person who counts the votes, makes the deals and gets the caucus into the chamber when it matters. Every MP remembers what you promised.
latest: Fully playable: the whole career, from rookie MP to Chief Whip

title: Season Ticket
summary: A soccer club management game set in Valmere, a made-up northern country. Own a club in the 16-team Kestrel Football League: run the business from your own 3D office, build the squad and the stadium, and change tactics while you watch the match. Play a whole career, on your phone, even offline.
latest: Out now: the first public release, with safer save codes

title: Garage to Glory
summary: A comedy band-career game. You're the drummer who started the band: play the gigs as rhythm games and steer the band through ten years, from your parents' garage in Saskatoon to arenas around the world, or a breakup in a parking lot.

title: AI Trading Journal
summary: My market views, the trades I take, and my running record, with notes from an AI coach on what to keep doing and what to fix.

title: Agent Fleet
summary: A set of small, single-purpose bots I can run from my phone, like news digests, trackers, and weekly scans.
